sn4.3:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena Bhagavā ratt-andhakāra-timisāyaṃ ajjhokāse nisinno hoti devo ca ekam ekaṃ phusāyati || || 3.
sn4.3:1.4: Atha kho Māro pāpimā Bhagavato bhayaṃ chambhitattaṃ loma-haṃsam uppādetu-kāmo yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || 4. Upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavato avidūre uccāvacā vaṇṇanibhā upadaṃseti subhā c-eva asubhā ca || || 5.
sn4.3:1.5: Atha kho Bhagavā Māro ayam pāpimā iti viditvā Māraṃ pāpimantam gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi || ||
